author: IGN YouTube
text:
GTA 6: All Randy's Car Locations | Complete Randy's Wish List Guide
Looking for all of Randy's car locations in GTA 6? Randy's Wish List tasks you with tracking down and stealing a collection of high-end vehicles across Leonida. While some cars have specific locations revealed through Randy's intel, others can randomly spawn at dealerships, luxury properties, car meets, and other locations throughout the map.
 
In this IGN guide video, we'll show you where to find every car on Randy's Wish List, what each vehicle looks like, and the best areas to search. We'll also explain how to unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, how Randy's vehicle intel works, and how to repair vehicles before delivering them.
 
Keep in mind that not every vehicle has a guaranteed spawn location. Some cars may appear in different spots within the areas shown in this video, while others require you to receive specific intel from Randy before they become available.

text:
The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum - Official End of Production Behind The Scenes (2027)
Don't miss the 'End of Production' Video for The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum, an upcoming film in the fantasy adventure franchise distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures. The announcement declares that the official production of The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum has ended, with a slated release in theaters for December 2027.

The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum stars Ian McKellen as Gandalf, Elijah Wood as Frodo, Lee Pace as Thranduil, Jamie Dornan as Aragorn, Anya Taylor-Joy as Seren, and Andy Serkis as Gollum. 

The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum opens in theaters on December 17, 2027.

text:
GTA 6 - How to Get Tank From a Secret Bunker
As soon as we booted up GTA 6 for the first time, we knew everyone would be looking at the most fun ways to blow stuff up. A tank definitely qualifies. But what started as a simple mission to grab this vehicle spiraled into a Cold War-era conspiracy storyline that had me solving the mystery of who assassinated the president. Come for the tank, stay for the intrigue. Here’s how to open a secret bunker to discover a tank (as well as some other goodies) in Grand Theft Auto 6.

Does GTA 6 Really "Play Best" On PS5? - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Digital Foundry has rendered their verdict on the GTA 6 PS5 vs Xbox Series X debate, and the results may surprise you. It also puts into question the game's PlayStation-centric marketing campaign. And speaking of, despite a marketing deal with Sony, CD Projekt is confirming that The Witcher 4 will remain multiplatform on release (whenever that is). And speaking of release dates, Hollow Knight: Silksong's DLC, Sea of Sorrow, is getting a special presentation this Friday (and the Internet thinks the game will also shadowdrop that same day).

Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair - Official Definitive Edition Release Date Trailer
Here's a look at the Definitive Edition Release Date Trailer for Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair, a new 2.5D adventure platformer developed by Playtonic Games. Players will take on the biggest challenge yet as they embark on the Impossible Lair. Push through challenges with enhanced visuals, improved performance, and additional content. The Definitive Edition for Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair is launching on December 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
